messages.author: cb65713c504cc909
messages.subject: facet_grid for more than 2 factors
parts:
Dear ggplot2 fans,

Does anybody know how to create a plot (in my case a point plot) in ggplot2 where I use facet_grid to arrange data according to two factors, but where I want to make another distinction based on a third factor. Below I created a fictional dataset. I want to make this additional distinction based on factor4. Now, I have solved this using different colours for the levels of factor 4. However, Instead I would like to have different panels with the levels of factor4 within the different levels of factor3. So, instead of using a colour code, I would like to subdivide the panels again. I hope I'm being clear?

Thanks!
ellen


cont_var<-rnorm(n=30)
cont_var
factor1<-c("site1","site2","site1","site1","site1","site2","site1","site1","site1","site2","site1","site3","site1","site2","site1","site2","site3","site2","site3","site1","site1","site2","site3","site1","site3","site1","site2","site2","site1","site1")
factor2<-rep(c("A","B"),each=15)
factor3<-c("treatment1","treatment2","treatment3","treatment2","treatment2","treatment1","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment1","treatment2","treatment2","treatment3","treatment3","treatment1","treatment1","treatment2","treatment3","treatment2","treatment1","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment2","treatment3")
factor4<-c("bla1","bla2","bla1","bla1","bla1","bla2","bla1","bla1","bla1","bla2","bla1","bla2","bla1","bla2","bla1","bla2","bla2","bla2","bla2","bla1","bla1","bla2","bla2","bla1","bla2","bla1","bla2","bla2","bla1","bla1")

dataset1<-data.frame(cont_var,factor1,factor2,factor3,factor4)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(dataset1,aes(factor1,cont_var,colour=factor4))+facet_grid(factor2~factor3)+geom_point()

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: facet_grid for more than 2 factors
parts:
Hi Ellen,

You can have more than one factor in the rows or columns, e.g.,

facet_grid(factor4 + factor2~factor3)

Best,
Ista
